Don't pass `-readonly` for fil"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"e-less queries (CSV/Parquet) — see the example above; `-readonly` is only for database files / remot"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"es (CSV/Parquet) — see the example above; `-readonly` is only for database files / remote databases."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**`duckdb: command not found`?**
The CLI isn't installed or isn't on PATH; run the platform install "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"script (`skills/data-insight-runbook/scripts/setup-duckdb.ps1` / `setup-duckdb.sh`) and reopen the t"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"`skills/data-insight-runbook/scripts/setup-duckdb.ps1` / `setup-duckdb.sh`) and reopen the terminal."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"**Garbled Chinese text in CSV?**
